source: 上外版选择性必修三 Unit 4 同主题完形(我的绿色日记/温室效应原理/拯救海龟/海滩清理日/融化的两极/校园环保)。用词限本单元/常见词,答案唯一,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。答案位由 _balance 打散。

passages.title: My Green Diary
passages.text: Last month our teacher asked us to keep a 'green diary' for thirty days. The (1)____ was simple: write down one small thing you did each day to help the (2)____. On the first day, I turned off the lights whenever I (3)____ a room. On the second day, I carried a cloth bag to the shop so that I would not need any plastic (4)____. Soon I began to (5)____ my own waste at home, dropping cans and bottles into the right (6)____. I also started to walk to school instead of asking my dad to (7)____ me. At first these changes felt too (8)____ to matter. But by the end of the month, my diary was full, and I felt (9)____ of what I had done. I learned that protecting the Earth does not need money or magic; it just needs us to form a few good (10)____ and keep them.

questions.explanation: the task was simple 任务很简单,名词。
help the environment 帮助环境。
whenever I left a room 每当离开房间,动词。
plastic bags 塑料袋,名词。
sort my own waste 给垃圾分类,动词。
into the right bin 投进正确的垃圾箱,名词。
ask my dad to drive me 让爸爸开车送我,动词。
too small to matter 太小而无足轻重,形容词。
felt proud of 为……感到自豪,形容词。
a few good habits 一些好习惯,名词。

passages.title: How the Greenhouse Effect Works
passages.text: Many people have heard of the greenhouse effect, but few really (1)____ how it works. Each day, sunlight (2)____ through the air and warms the ground beneath our feet. After dark, the warm Earth sends this heat back (3)____ the sky. In a healthy world, the heat that comes in by day and (4)____ at night stays in balance. The problem begins when there is too much carbon dioxide in the (5)____. This gas tends to (6)____ part of the heat, so it cannot escape into space. As a (7)____, the planet keeps more warmth than it needs, and its average (8)____ slowly climbs. A little of this effect is (9)____, for without it the Earth would be far too cold for life. Too much of it, however, is (10)____, and that is the danger we must face today.

questions.explanation: understand how it works 理解它如何运作,动词。
sunlight travels through 阳光穿过,动词。
back into the sky 回到天空,介词。
the heat that … leaves at night 夜间离开,动词。
in the atmosphere 在大气中,名词。
block part of the heat 阻挡部分热量,动词。
as a result 结果,固定搭配。
its average temperature 平均气温,名词。
a little of this effect is helpful 有益的,形容词。
too much of it is dangerous 危险的,形容词。

passages.title: Saving the Sea Turtles
passages.text: On a quiet beach in summer, a group of students worked hard to (1)____ the sea turtles. Their teacher had told them a sad (2)____: many turtles die after eating plastic bags, which they (3)____ for jellyfish. The students did not want this to (4)____ near their own home. First, they walked along the sand and (5)____ up every piece of rubbish they could find. Then they put up bright (6)____ to remind visitors to take their litter home. One girl explained that even a single bag could (7)____ a turtle's stomach and cause it to starve. The work was tiring, and the sun was (8)____, but nobody wanted to stop. By evening, the beach was clean again, and everyone felt (9)____ that they had done something real. They knew that the ocean could not protect itself, so it was up to people to (10)____ after it.

questions.explanation: protect the sea turtles 保护海龟,动词。
a sad story 一个悲伤的故事,名词。
mistake … for jellyfish 误认为水母,动词。
did not want this to happen 不想这发生,动词。
picked up every piece of rubbish 捡起垃圾,动词。
put up bright signs 立起醒目的标牌,名词。
block a turtle's stomach 堵住海龟的胃,动词。
the sun was hot 太阳很烈,形容词。
felt glad that 感到高兴,形容词。
look after it 照看它,动词短语 look after。

passages.title: A Beach Clean-up Day
passages.text: Every spring, our town holds a special (1)____ called Ocean Clean-up Day. Hundreds of (2)____ come to the coast early in the morning, each carrying a bag and a pair of gloves. Their (3)____ is to remove as much rubbish from the beach as they can. If the litter is (4)____ now, it will not flow out to the sea and (5)____ problems for the animals there. Last year I took (6)____ for the first time. I was surprised by how much plastic I found buried in the (7)____. Bottles, cups and broken toys were everywhere. By noon, our small team had (8)____ more than twenty bags. The leader told us that this rubbish would now be (9)____ instead of left in nature. Tired but happy, I understood that one clean beach was only the (10)____; the real goal was to make people produce less waste all year round.

questions.explanation: a special event 一个特别的活动,名词。
Hundreds of volunteers 数百名志愿者,名词。
their goal is to remove rubbish 目标,名词。
if the litter is collected now 被收集起来,动词(被动)。
cause problems for the animals 给动物带来麻烦,动词。
took part 参加,take part(in)固定搭配。
buried in the sand 埋在沙子里,名词。
had filled more than twenty bags 装满了二十多个袋子,动词。
would now be recycled 将被回收,动词(被动)。
only the start 仅仅是开始,名词。

passages.title: The Melting Poles
passages.text: Far to the north and south of the world lie two great fields of ice. For thousands of years they stayed (1)____ and still, deep and white. Today, however, scientists are (2)____. The Earth is slowly growing warmer, and the ice has begun to (3)____. As the temperature (4)____, summers become a little hotter and winters a little milder. Bit by bit, the great glaciers (5)____ towards the mountains, leaving bare rock behind. When ice on the land turns to water, that water flows into the (6)____, and the level of the sea rises. Many low-lying cities along the coast could one day be in (7)____. This is why the melting of the ice is seen as such a serious (8)____. Researchers watch the poles (9)____, hoping the world will act in time. They remind us that the cold, distant ice is closely (10)____ to the lives of people everywhere.

questions.explanation: stayed frozen and still 保持冰冻,形容词。
scientists are worried 科学家很担忧,形容词。
the ice has begun to melt 冰开始融化,动词。
as the temperature rises 随着气温上升,动词。
the glaciers retreat 冰川退缩,动词。
flows into the sea 流入大海,名词。
be in danger 处于危险中,名词。
such a serious problem 如此严重的问题,名词。
watch the poles closely 密切关注,副词。
closely linked to 与……紧密相连,动词(过去分词)。

passages.title: Going Green at School
passages.text: This year our Green Club decided to make our school more (1)____ to the environment. We started with a simple (2)____: to cut down the rubbish we produce every day. First, we placed clearly marked (3)____ in every classroom so that students could (4)____ paper, cans and bottles. Next, we asked the canteen to use fewer plastic boxes and more (5)____ that can be washed and used again. We also reminded everyone to (6)____ off the lights and fans when the last person leaves a room, which saves a lot of (7)____. At first, some classmates thought our ideas were too much (8)____. But once they saw how easy the new habits were, more and more of them (9)____ in. By the end of the term, our school had produced far less waste, and we felt that our small club had made a real (10)____.

questions.explanation: more friendly to the environment 对环境更友好,形容词。
a simple goal 一个简单的目标,名词。
clearly marked bins 标记清楚的垃圾箱,名词。
sort paper, cans and bottles 给纸、罐、瓶分类,动词。
boxes that can be washed and used again 可重复使用的盒子,名词。
turn off the lights 关灯,动词短语 turn off。
saves a lot of energy 节省大量能源,名词。
too much trouble 太麻烦,名词。
more of them joined in 加入进来,动词短语 join in。
made a real difference 带来真正的改变,名词。
